idea-plugin.name: Maven Consistency Enforcer
idea-plugin.description:
Maven Consistency Enforcer (MCE)
Stop fighting ghosts in your classpath! MCE ensures your IntelliJ IDEA run-time classpath matches the code in your workspace in multi-module Maven projects by detecting and removing stale JAR artifacts and preferring local module sources when available.
What it does: - Automatically removes attached JARs that shadow local modules - Replaces library entries with module dependencies when a matching module exists - Per-module enforcement configuration and global "All modules" toggle - Shows notifications and a status bar widget with enforcement metrics
Behavior: - Triggers automatically after Maven > Reload Project and on project startup (optional auto reimport) - Notifies you of fixes and exposes quick toggles in the Tools menu and status bar

action.description: Toggle the automatic Maven consistency enforcements on or off
